# Retrieval and Knowledge Engineering for Language Model Systems

> Build and measure the retrieval layer of a language model system: search, corpus preparation, access, agents and structured data. SDAIA Academy course AE-304, version 2027.1.0, in English.

Each slide is a heading such as "#### [day1#slide-id] Title": cite slides by that id, and each citation is a link (slides/day1.html#slide-id). These files are what a trainee sees: no speaker notes and no answer keys.

## Course

- [Course page](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-304/index.md): overview, outcomes, schedule and labs; the page itself is https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-304/index.html
- [The whole course](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-304/llms-full.txt): every unit, session and slide in one file, about 20,821 tokens
- [Practice questions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-304/practice.html): questions to check yourself, with feedback after each answer

## Slides

- [Day 1: Measure and search](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-304/slides/day1.md): sessions: Retrieval is measured on its own, Lexical search and Arabic text, Dense retrieval and embedding choice, Hybrid search and reranking; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-304/slides/day1.html; about 5,307 tokens
- [Day 2: Prepare the corpus](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-304/slides/day2.md): sessions: Parsing is a separate problem, Chunking by structure, Dates, versions and duplicates, Permissions in the index; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-304/slides/day2.html; about 5,038 tokens
- [Day 3: Agentic search and knowledge](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-304/slides/day3.md): sessions: Search as tools for an agent, Multi-step questions, Paging and offloading, Knowledge graphs for linked facts; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-304/slides/day3.html; about 4,535 tokens
- [Day 4: Structured data and diagnosis](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-304/slides/day4.md): sessions: Questions over a warehouse, Semantic layers and validated SQL, Cost, latency and freshness, Diagnosing failures by component; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-304/slides/day4.html; about 4,873 tokens
- [Capstone: Capstone project presentations](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-304/slides/capstone.md): page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-304/slides/capstone.html; about 681 tokens

## Labs

- [Lab 1.1: Graded judgements and a baseline score](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-304/labs/D1_1_judge_graded_relevance.ipynb): Day 1, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 1.2: BM25 with and without Arabic normalisation](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-304/labs/D1_2_run_bm25_without.ipynb): Day 1, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 1.3: Two embedding models: quality, size and latency](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-304/labs/D1_3_embed_300_page.ipynb): Day 1, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 1.4: Fusion, a reranker and its latency](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-304/labs/D1_4_fuse_lexical_dense.ipynb): Day 1, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 2.1: Two parsers scored on 30 pages](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-304/labs/D2_1_score_two_parsers.ipynb): Day 2, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 2.2: Two chunkings of the study plans](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-304/labs/D2_2_chunk_study_plans.ipynb): Day 2, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 2.3: Effective dates, versions and duplicates](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-304/labs/D2_3_add_effective_dates.ipynb): Day 2, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 2.4: Role labels and leak tests](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-304/labs/D2_4_tag_chunks_role.ipynb): Day 2, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 3.1: Three search tools and a traced agent](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-304/labs/D3_1_expose_file_listing.ipynb): Day 3, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 3.2: Single-shot against iterative search](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-304/labs/D3_2_compare_single_shot.ipynb): Day 3, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 3.3: Offloading large results to files](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-304/labs/D3_3_offload_large_search.ipynb): Day 3, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 3.4: A graph of courses, prerequisites and rules](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-304/labs/D3_4_build_small_graph.ipynb): Day 3, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 4.1: Free text-to-SQL on 20 statistical questions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-304/labs/D4_1_run_free_text.ipynb): Day 4, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 4.2: Governed metrics and validated SQL](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-304/labs/D4_2_answer_same_questions.ipynb): Day 4, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 4.3: Cost per question, tail latency and re-index time](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-304/labs/D4_3_measure_cost_per.ipynb): Day 4, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 4.4: Twenty failures, attributed by component](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-304/labs/D4_4_attribute_20_failures.ipynb): Day 4, Session 4, 25 min
